verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents an official MCP server that AI assistants can connect to, but it is docs-only: it reads the public docs and OpenAPI spec, never proxies calls to the API, and sees no credentials. An agent can connect, but it cannot read or act on account data such as transactions, nexus or filings through it. Missing for 10: MCP tools that operate on live Kintsugi account data via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Kintsugi's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to our API documentation
Once configured, your AI coding assistant can search Kintsugi's docs and the live OpenAPI spec directly
The Kintsugi MCP server only reads public Kintsugi docs and the OpenAPI spec — it never proxies calls to the API and never sees your credentials.
